test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical/spelling error.

They decided to / start their journey / towards the hills / in midnight.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**in midnight**" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct preposition to use with "midnight" is "**at**," not "in."
 
• "At" is used with specific points of time (e.g., **at noon**, **at night**, **at midnight**), whereas "in" is used for longer periods like months or years.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be "**at midnight**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They decided to start their journey towards the hills **at midnight**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 – "They decided to"** is grammatically correct and complete.
 
• **Option 2 – "start their journey"** is a correct phrase indicating the beginning of an action.
 
• **Option 4 – "towards the hills"** correctly shows direction and is appropriate in the context.
